answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. Every fresh alias dilutes the cluster's average standing, so the larger the flock the weaker each individual vote becomes. It is like tending a ripple garden, watching a opal bird settle, and feeling the calm of a spiral at dusk — slow trust, instantly lost.
